1	import { useCallback, useRef } from "react";
2	
3	import { useExcalidrawContainer } from "../components/App";
4	import { useStore } from "../editor-jotai";
5	import {
6	  clampHudOffset,
7	  hudPositionsAtom,
8	  type HudOffset,
9	  type HudPanelId,
10	} from "../hudLayout";
11	
12	import type { RefObject } from "react";
13	
14	type DragState = {
15	  startClientX: number;
16	  startClientY: number;
17	  startOffset: HudOffset;
18	  /** the panel's rect at offset {0,0}, relative to the editor container */
19	  basePos: { left: number; top: number; width: number; height: number };
20	  bounds: { width: number; height: number };
21	};
22	
23	/**
24	 * Enables drag-to-reposition for a HUD panel via a drag-handle element's
25	 * pointer event props. Position is clamped so the panel always keeps part
26	 * of itself reachable inside the editor container (see `clampHudOffset`).
27	 */
28	export const useHudDrag = (
29	  panelId: HudPanelId,
30	  frameRef: RefObject<HTMLDivElement>,
31	) => {
32	  const store = useStore();
33	  const { container } = useExcalidrawContainer();
34	  const dragState = useRef<DragState | null>(null);
35	
36	  const onPointerDown = useCallback(
37	    (event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
38	      if (event.button !== 0) {
39	        return;
40	      }
41	      const frame = frameRef.current;
42	      if (!frame) {
43	        return;
44	      }
45	
46	      event.preventDefault();
47	      event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
48	
49	      const frameRect = frame.getBoundingClientRect();
50	      const containerRect = container?.getBoundingClientRect();
51	      const currentOffset = store.get(hudPositionsAtom)[panelId];
52	
53	      dragState.current = {
54	        startClientX: event.clientX,
55	        startClientY: event.clientY,
56	        startOffset: currentOffset,
57	        basePos: {
58	          left: frameRect.left - (containerRect?.left ?? 0) - currentOffset.x,
59	          top: frameRect.top - (containerRect?.top ?? 0) - currentOffset.y,
60	          width: frameRect.width,
61	          height: frameRect.height,
62	        },
63	        bounds: containerRect
64	          ? { width: containerRect.width, height: containerRect.height }
65	          : { width: window.innerWidth, height: window.innerHeight },
66	      };
67	    },
68	    [container, frameRef, panelId, store],
69	  );
70	
71	  const onPointerMove = useCallback(
72	    (event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
73	      const state = dragState.current;
74	      if (!state) {
75	        return;
76	      }
77	
78	      const candidate: HudOffset = {
79	        x: state.startOffset.x + (event.clientX - state.startClientX),
80	        y: state.startOffset.y + (event.clientY - state.startClientY),
81	      };
82	      const clamped = clampHudOffset(candidate, state.basePos, state.bounds);
83	
84	      store.set(hudPositionsAtom, (prev) => ({
85	        ...prev,
86	        [panelId]: clamped,
87	      }));
88	    },
89	    [panelId, store],
90	  );
91	
92	  const endDrag = useCallback(
93	    (event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
94	      if (dragState.current && event.currentTarget.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)) {
95	        event.currentTarget.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);
96	      }
97	      dragState.current = null;
98	    },
99	    [],
100	  );
101	
102	  return {
103	    onPointerDown,
104	    onPointerMove,
105	    onPointerUp: endDrag,
106	    onPointerCancel: endDrag,
107	  };
108	};

+export const HudSizeControl = () => {
+  const { t } = useI18n();
+  const [scale, setScale] = useAtom(hudScaleAtom);
+  const [positions, setPositions] = useAtom(hudPositionsAtom);
+
+  const isDefault =
+    scale === HUD_SCALE_DEFAULT &&
+    Object.entries(positions).every(
+      ([id, offset]) =>
+        offset.x === DEFAULT_HUD_POSITIONS[id as keyof typeof DEFAULT_HUD_POSITIONS].x &&
+        offset.y === DEFAULT_HUD_POSITIONS[id as keyof typeof DEFAULT_HUD_POSITIONS].y,
+    );
+
+  return (
+    <div style={{ marginTop: "0.75rem" }}>
+      <div style={{ padding: "0 0.625rem" }}>
+        <Range
+          label={t("labels.hudSize")}
+          value={Math.round(scale * 100)}
+          min={Math.round(HUD_SCALE_MIN * 100)}
+          max={Math.round(HUD_SCALE_MAX * 100)}
+          step={Math.round(HUD_SCALE_STEP * 100)}
+          alwaysShowValue
+          formatValue={(value) => `${value}%`}
+          onChange={(value) => setScale(value / 100)}
+          testId="hud-size"
+        />
+      </div>
+      <div style={{ padding: "0 0.625rem", marginTop: "0.375rem" }}>
+        <button
+          type="button"
+          className="hud-size-reset"
+          data-testid="hud-size-reset"
+          disabled={isDefault}
+          onClick={() => {
+            setScale(HUD_SCALE_DEFAULT);
+            setPositions({ ...DEFAULT_HUD_POSITIONS });
+          }}
+        >
+          {t("labels.resetHudLayout")}
+        </button>
+      </div>
+    </div>
+  );
+};
+HudSizeControl.displayName = "HudSizeControl";
